violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Observed boxes of food on floor of walk in freezer.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Observed handle of scoop was in cheese in pizza cold hold unit.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Observed doors and sides of appliances need to be cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Observed cracks in floor tile in food prep area. Observed floor in walk in cooler is worn down and no longer cleanable.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Observed floors in food prep area need to be cleaned.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. -Observed open bag of food in walk in freezer.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Observed ice chute on soda dispenser needs to be cleaned.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -Observed traction pads in walk in cooler are uncleanable.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -Observed traction pads in walk in cooler are soiled and uncleanable.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
